data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 we released prior year reserves of $110.0m (2017: $176.9m). Our specialty lines division increased reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures. Specialty lines releases also included amounts from the cyber portfolio, an area that has more variability than the rest of the specialty lines account. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect of reduced margins on reserve releases, along with the effects of a large series of natural disasters, is now visible. Property has been significantly impacted by higher attritional claims, as well as some strengthening on the 2017 catastrophe estimates during the year. As a result property was the only division that had a strengthening of reserves for 2018 of $48.0m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding of 3,381.5 (USD millions). During 2018 the syndicate recorded a net release of prior year reserves of $110.0m (reported in the managing agent commentary), driven largely by favourable development in specialty lines (including cyber) as older portfolios matured. Offsetting this were adverse developments in property where higher attritional claims and some strengthening on 2017 catastrophe estimates led to a strengthening of reserves for property of $48.0m. Overall the prior year movement is reported as a release.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (insurance liabilities) figure was found. The managing agent narrative states a prior year release of $110.0m but does not specify whether this is gross or net of reinsurance; per the extraction rules this report therefore uses the reported $110.0m as the best available quantified prior-year movement but flags it as NET-of-reinsurance fallback. Property strengthening of $48.0m is explicitly stated. All monetary amounts are in the syndicate's functional/presentation currency (USD millions). Mapping of 'Specialty lines' movements to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate where needed; where amounts were not quantified they are left null.
